withheld.name: @dzup-ui/compat
withheld.reason: Public and publishable (0.1.0-alpha.0, `publishConfig.access: public`, included in ci.yml's pack smoke test) but on the changesets `ignore` list, so no changeset can ever release it. VERSIONING.md 5 treats compat as migration tooling with no stable API of its own, which is a reason to withhold it, not a reason it cannot be released. Owner decision N5-01-D2.

withheld.name: @dzup-ui/codemods
withheld.reason: Same as compat. The cost is measurable: .changeset/pro-package-is-named-dzup-ui-pro-pro.md describes a behaviour change to `@dzup-ui/codemods`' `rename-imports` in its body and cannot name it in its frontmatter, because a changeset naming an ignored package alongside a published one is refused outright (the SK-1 failure). The change ships with no changelog entry. Owner decision N5-01-D2.
